oral_examination.oral_examination: *36 A small area of ​​the crown can be seen on the mesial and lingual side, with caries and 1 degree looseness, probing (-) and percussion (-). Nothing special.

source_handle: *36 Local disinfection with povidone-iodine, alveolar nerve block anesthesia with lidocaine hydrochloride, and local infiltration anesthesia with bistriol. After the anesthesia takes effect, separate the gums, divide the roots, loosen the roots of the teeth, and remove them with tooth extraction forceps. Routinely scratch the tooth extraction wound and apply pressure to stop bleeding.
